today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,332.6, a fifth straight lower print and -$127.7 (-2.86%) from $4,460.3 five sessions ago. The book stays call-dominated at P/C OI 0.38 with the $4,500 call wall (12,108 contracts) capping $168 above spot, while the nominal $3,500 put wall (5,546) sits 19% below and offers no near-term defense. Headline max pain $5,570 is a legacy-OI artifact of deep call stock at $6,000/$8,000/$10,000; the local pin within +/-$400 of spot is $4,730. ATM IV 23.74% prices a 1-sigma daily move of $64.79 (1.50%).
five_day_thesis: The defining change over five sessions is that price fell 2.86% and bought no volatility: ATM IV went 23.78% -> 23.74% (-0.04pp), so the entire slide has been sold as orderly, and downside premium never repriced. Beneath that calm, the dealer cushion eroded hard - net GEX within +/-$200 of spot decayed 268.5 -> 232.7 -> 231.7 -> 156.0 -> 114.7, a 57% collapse, and what is left is not a cushion at all: sub-spot strikes sum to -105.5 and the positive headline comes almost entirely from $4,500 (+141.1) and $4,510 (+67.0), both above the market. Strip those two and the local book reads -93.3 - dealers damp rallies into $4,500 and accelerate breaks below $4,325. Positioning diverged from price: call OI grew +18,019 to 219,380 while put OI added only +2,749 to 82,841, but the new call length went into $6,000 and $5,500 lottery strikes (787 and 773 lots traded), not into anything that defends spot. The only genuine demand shift is downside: put volume ran 2,014 -> 3,589 (+78%) and today's single largest print in the entire chain was 1,311 lots of the $4,200 put.

prediction: Bias lower while spot holds under $4,400. Spot at $4,332.6 sits in a negative-gamma pocket - $4,325 (-11.0), $4,300 (-28.6), $4,250 (-23.3), $4,200 (-30.0) - so a break of $4,325 hands dealers short gamma into the $4,200 put concentration with no IV bid to slow it. Reclaiming $4,500 is what invalidates: that strike alone carries +141.1 GEX and flips dealers to fading extremes.
